import pytest
from src.user_authentication import User, UserAuthenticator
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from jose import JWTError, jwt
from passlib.context import CryptContext

crypto_context = CryptContext(schemes=['bcrypt'], deprecated='auto')
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl='/token')

class TestUserAuthentication:
    def test_register_ok(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        user = authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        assert user.email == "alice@example.com"
        assert user.password_hash is not None

    def test_register_duplicate_email(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "another_password")
        assert exc.value.status_code == 409
        assert exc.value.detail == 'Email already registered'

    def test_register_weak_password(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "short")
        assert exc.value.status_code == 422
        assert exc.value.detail == 'Weak password'

    def test_login_correct_password(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        user = authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        token = authenticator.login("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        try:
            jwt.decode(token, 'secret_key', algorithms=['HS256'])
        except JWTError:
            pytest.fail('Failed to decode the token')

    def test_login_correct_email_wrong_password(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        user = authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            authenticator.login("alice@example.com", "wrong_password")
        assert exc.value.status_code == 401
        assert exc.value.detail == 'Invalid credentials'

    def test_login_rate_limit(self):
        authenticator = UserAuthenticator()
        user = authenticator.register("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        for _ in range(6):
            authenticator.login("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            authenticator.login("alice@example.com", "hunter2")
        assert exc.value.status_code == 429
        assert exc.value.detail == 'Too many failed login attempts in the last 5 minutes'
